import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the Assessment data
df = pd.read_excel('/work/students_2025_26.xlsx', sheet_name='Assessment')

n = len(df)
print(f\"Total rows: {n}\")

# Extract baseline assessment data (rows 1-320, index 1 to 320)
# Columns: 0=RollNo, 1=Name, 4=MathScore
baseline_list = []
for idx in range(1, 321):
    row = df.iloc[idx]
    roll_no = row.iloc[0]
    name = row.iloc[1]
    math_score = row.iloc[4]
    if pd.notna(roll_no) and pd.notna(name):
        baseline_list.append({
            'RollNo': roll_no,
            'Name': name,
            'MathScore_Baseline': math_score
        })

baseline_df = pd.DataFrame(baseline_list)
print(f\"Baseline records: {len(baseline_df)}\")

# Extract endline assessment data (rows 324-615, starting after the \"Endline Assessment\" header)
# Looking at row 323: ['Student Name', 'Class', 'Reading Level', 'Math Score (/20)', nan]
# So the actual data starts from row 324
endline_list = []
for idx in range(324, n):
    row = df.iloc[idx]
    name = row.iloc[0]  # Name is now in column 0
    # Math Score is in column 3 (shifted)
    math_score_col = row.iloc[3]
    if pd.notna(name) and pd.notna(math_score_col):
        endline_list.append({
            'Name': name,
            'MathScore_Endline': math_score_col
        })

endline_df = pd.DataFrame(endline_list)
print(f\"Endline records: {len(endline_df)}\")

# Merge the two datasets
merged = baseline_df.merge(endline_df, on='Name', how='left')
print(f\"\\nMerged dataframe shape: {merged.shape}\")

# Find students who have baseline but no endline score (dropped out)
dropped_out = merged[merged['MathScore_Endline'].isna()]
print(f\"\\nStudents who dropped out: {len(dropped_out)}\")

print(\"\\nDropped out students:\")
print(dropped_out[['RollNo', 'Name', 'MathScore_Baseline']].to_string())
EOF"
